title: Hi Mum, New Number
intro: A message arrives from an unknown number. It says it is your child, with a new phone.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Hi Mum, my phone broke, this is my new number

screen.context: You are a parent. Your child's real number is saved in your contacts.

msg: ? I cannot use my banking app on the new phone.
Please pay this bill for me,

msg.text: I cannot talk, I am in a meeting. I will explain later.

newnum.label: A "new number"
newnum.lens: You have the real number saved.
newnum.why: Check by calling the number you already have.

fav.label: A "favour" about money
fav.lens: The first real request is money.
fav.why: Strangers using family names ask for money first.

acct.label: A stranger's account number
acct.lens: Money to an account you do not know.
acct.why: Never pay an account a "relative" sends by text.

nocall.label: Cannot talk or call
nocall.why: A real child will answer a call.

num.label: An unknown number
num.lens: A number you do not know.
num.why: A new number can be real, so check, do not guess.

hi.label: "Hi Mum"
hi.why: It is a guess that fits many parents.

actions.label: Call my child on the number I already have

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your phone company can block the number.

verify.line: You called the old number. Your child answered at once, safe and puzzled. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The $370 went to a stranger. Your child had lost nothing.

what_if.go_ahead: One call to the number you already have would have ended it. A message is not proof.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: If a "relative" texts from a new number and wants money, call their old number first.

quick_check.q: A text from a new number says "Hi Mum, my phone broke" and asks you to pay a bill. What do you do?

options.text: Call your child on the number you already have

quick_check.explain: Call the old number. A real child answers.

hints.nudge: How can you check without trusting the message?

rows.v: Check on a number you already know

rows.k: A message asking for money fast
